Sam: FYI — Altair postmortem published: <https://docs.redwood.ai/postmortems/altair-vpc-peering|altair-vpc-peering-postmortem>
Sam: TL;DR: recurring VPC flaps -> on‑prem firewall stateful timeout + our peerlink backoff bug. Need clear owners + timelines for remediation.
Jess: I'll take firewall runbook + verification with Altair. ETA Tue 2026-04-06.
Anya: I'll own the runtime fallback/peerlink backoff fix. Plan: quick patch -> canary -> prod. ETA EOW.
Mike: I'll own the on‑prem ops checklist and CLA handback for Altair side changes. Will sync with customer infra.
Anya: Patch plan outline: increment backoff cap, add jitter, add grpc retry hook.
Anya: code snippet:
```
// peerlink config snippet
max_backoff_ms = 2000
enable_jitter = true
```
Jess: For firewall: ask Altair to increase conntrack timeout from 30s -> 300s for our keepalives. I'll provide exact tcpdump hints.
Nikhil: I'll add SRE playbook entries and an alert: vpc_peering_iorate spike -> page on 3 consecutive mins.
prodops-bot: Tickets created: INF-4523 (peerlink fix), INF-4524 (firewall runbook), INF-4525 (onprem checklist).
Sam: Action list — (1) Peerlink fix: owner @Anya, INF-4523, ETA 4d; (2) Firewall runbook + customer test: owner @Jess, INF-4524, ETA 5d; (3) On‑prem checklist + CLA: owner @Mike, INF-4525, ETA 7d; (4) Post‑deploy smoke & monitoring: owner @Nikhil, ETA 1d after each deploy.
Jess: Scheduling customer call Thu 10am PT to coordinate firewall changes and test window.
Anya: I'll land the canary patch and ping this thread once it's on dedicated.
Mike: Putting follow‑up on Monday eng‑sre agenda so we don't lose momentum.
Sam: We should also track recurrence window — monitor for 30 days after fixes.
Nikhil: Adding retrospective metric: peering_flap_count (30d rolling) and a dashboard panel.
Jess: @Altair: expect contact from us to coordinate the firewall change and the smoke test. :wave:
Sam: Marking this thread closed for assignment. Reopen here with deploy notes or any regressions.
